mapper.select: select count(*) as total_hits, coalesce(sum(case when h.suppressed = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as actionable_hits, coalesce(sum(case when h.suppressed = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as suppressed_hits, count(distinct h.device_code, h.event_id) as distinct_events, count(distinct h.rule_code) as distinct_rules from t_rule_hit h

select h.action_type as code, count(*) as count from t_rule_hit h
group by h.action_type order by h.action_type

select count(*) as total_hits, coalesce(sum(case when h.suppressed = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as actionable_hits, coalesce(sum(case when h.suppressed = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as suppressed_hits, count(distinct h.device_code, h.event_id) as distinct_events, count(distinct h.rule_code) as distinct_rules from t_rule_hit h
h.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
